description: Pushed machine-backup state for Loem and Note: complete restore point freshness, independent telemetry heartbeats, operation results, shared Storage Box quota, integrity checks, coverage and restore rehearsals. A complete capture is required for freshness; peer observations retain their observer identity.
title: Automated backups · recovery and storage

panels.description: Time since the latest received push for each enrolled machine. Heartbeats run every five minutes independently of backup and monitor locks. A peer-declared host that has never pushed reads Never recorded. Old values remain visible for the one-month retention window; overdue telemetry is not proof of a backup failure.
panels.title: Telemetry age

panels.description: Age from capture, using the newest complete restore point known by any observer. Limit: two hours. Zero completion timestamps mean no complete point; failed or partial candidates cannot advance this value. Cross-check telemetry and repository contact age.
panels.title: Services data age

panels.description: Age from capture of complete home data. Limit: twelve hours, with uploads every six hours. Peer observations cover clients that have not yet sent their own telemetry. Never recorded means no complete point is known.
panels.title: Home data age

panels.description: Recorded backup health by host and scope, including failures from before telemetry was installed. Unknown or unchecked components remain absent. This records health transitions; the operation results below record individual attempts after activation.
panels.title: Backup health
Restore point freshness and operation results

panels.description: Latest complete restore point age by source host and scope, across observer reports. Thirty-minute hold spans the five-minute push interval; it stops bridging long telemetry outages. Review the heartbeat stat for stale senders.
panels.title: Complete data age · services and home

panels.description: Warnings and critical states from freshness, repository, capacity, capture and inventory checks. Peer freshness series retain both observer host and source_host. No messages, source paths, credentials or snapshot IDs are metric labels.
panels.title: Recorded health checks

panels.description: Final results for backups, monitoring, maintenance and rehearsals since telemetry was installed. Delivery failures do not change these outcomes. A killed operation is detected through missing completion and freshness rather than being fabricated as a finished run.
panels.title: Last operation result

panels.description: Wall-clock duration of each last finished operation, including failed attempts. Available after a new operation completes with the updated runner.
panels.title: Last operation duration

panels.description: Cumulative successes and failures since this machine’s local backup state was created. Counts survive telemetry outages and reset if local state is lost; these are not lifetime repository totals.
panels.title: Finished operation counts

panels.description: Bytes scanned for the last completed upload. Older completions lack summary fields and remain No data until a new successful upload.
panels.title: Last complete backup · source size

panels.description: Packed repository bytes added by the last complete upload. This reflects deduplication and compression, rather than total source size. It is a per-run gauge, not a cumulative bandwidth counter.
panels.title: Last complete backup · new packed data

panels.description: Estimate from purchased capacity minus df free quota, including space unavailable due to provider snapshots. Warnings at 70%, critical at 85%. Each observer is separate; verify accounting in Hetzner Console and check measurement age.
panels.title: Storage Box quota used

panels.description: Age of the last successful quota measurement, separate from the telemetry heartbeat. A failed capacity check retains the old measurement instead of reporting zero usage. The monitor warns after twelve hours without a measurement.
panels.title: Capacity measurement age

panels.description: Last successful repository freshness check on each observer. The monitor runs every fifteen minutes. Heartbeats can still arrive while repository access fails, so heartbeat freshness alone does not imply reachable restore data.
panels.title: Repository contact age

panels.description: Last successful structure check plus a rotating quarter of repository data, from the shared maintenance owner Loem. Weekly checks rotate through four quarters. This does not establish an application restore.
panels.title: Integrity check age · Loem

panels.description: Fixed purchased quota and free bytes observed by each host. Provider snapshots affect free quota; usage is not obtained by summing restic snapshot sizes.
panels.title: Purchased quota and available space

panels.description: Last successfully finished integrity check, retention and prune on Loem. A dry run does not update this timestamp.
panels.title: Maintenance age · Loem
Coverage, notification delivery and restore evidence

panels.description: Unclassified persistent-state paths and inspection issues, counted without exposing paths in metrics. Inspect machine-backup status or the inventory report to identify the sources.
panels.title: Coverage inspection findings

panels.description: Age of the last completed service-state inventory. A current telemetry heartbeat can carry a stale inventory after a failed monitor.
panels.title: Coverage inspection age

panels.description: Undelivered health transitions retained by the runner. Queue depth zero does not establish successful delivery; check the separate delivery result.
panels.title: Pending Gotify notifications

panels.description: Last notification delivery check. Missing credentials or network errors keep transitions queued. No delivery check remains No data.
panels.title: Gotify delivery result

panels.description: Cumulative failed pushes retained in local state and exported on the next successful delivery. During an outage, use heartbeat age; the unreachable sink cannot receive its own failure immediately.
panels.title: Telemetry delivery failures

panels.description: Age since verification completed, keyed by restored host and scope and labeled with the observer that performed it. The restored snapshot capture time does not substitute for rehearsal time. No completed rehearsal remains No data.
panels.title: Restore rehearsal age

panels.description: Duration of the last successful isolated file/database rehearsal. Application startup is a separate confirmation; the runner checks files and archive readability.
panels.title: Restore verification duration

panels.description: A partial selection cannot prove complete scope recovery. Application startup currently remains unverified by the runner, even after file integrity checks succeed.
panels.title: Restore evidence limitations
